plan.summary: This 4-week block is the opening building phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan with only 1 S&C session per week, so each session covers the highest-value full-body work without adding excess fatigue to sparring and skill practice. Week 1 establishes a training max for the main squat pattern, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The focus is simple power first, then strength, then a few practical accessories to build general athletic qualities safely.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power, full-body strength, and trunk support while keeping fatigue low enough for boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep explosive output crisp without letting sparring fatigue bury lifting quality.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward faster explosive expression while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast and high as possible. Land softly and stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height you can land on cleanly without tucking hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Pause briefly at the bottom and drive straight up.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work to one hard but technically solid top set. Leave no grindy extra attempts. This sets your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your training numbers.
